source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 ("Unopposed returns: five to be fought")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Contests from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8; unopposed returns from the News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7, and the Irish News of the same date. The Lisburn rural list ('returned unopposed: ... Ballyscolly - William R. Totten ... Lissue - Mrs. Muriel G. Linton') read on the News-Letter page image.

note: Triennial election for the 21 seats, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Eleven divisions were contested and ten were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the citation now names the page that prints William R. Totten's unopposed return (was the Irish News, 6 May 1967, p. 9, which does not).
